with

Copy prompt
Find [number] companies and contacts that match my ideal customer profile: [industry, company size, role, region]. Use [CRM, LinkedIn, or lead sources] to vet each one and give me a table with name, company, why they fit and a confidence score. Then propose a cold outreach plan with message angles. Don't contact anyone or add records to my CRM until I approve the list.
